lessons.title: Build a qualified community argument
lessons.outcome: Practise build a qualified community argument. Readiness concerns the listed controlled distinctions; the connected application is optional self-review.

targets.label: Match a claim to its evidence
Keep an objection inside the recommendation

formModels.description: Un sondaggio tra i partecipanti describes those respondents, not all residents. Nei giorni osservati limits a claim to the observed days. Choose a measured recommendation rather than turning a preference into a proven effect.

Sebbene + subjunctive acknowledges a real obstacle; tuttavia introduces the recommendation that survives it. A concession does not erase the obstacle. The supplied forms sia and siano follow the singular or plural subject.

targets.label: Make a concession conditional
Clarify the point of disagreement

formModels.description: Possiamo… purché… offers a concession with a retained condition. Purché takes the subjunctive: sia for one thing, siano for several. Distinguish a proposed arrangement from an agreement already reached.

Intendevo… corrects your intended meaning. Non… ma… replaces the mistaken reading while retaining the relevant contrast. A helpful response names the disputed point and offers an actionable alternative.

targets.label: Preserve source and information status
Keep the action the recipient needs

formModels.description: Secondo l’avviso attributes a claim. È confermato and è provvisorio distinguish accepted information from a detail that may change. Non è indicato reports a missing detail without guessing it.
A useful brief retains who is affected, when and the required action. Omit background that does not help this recipient, but do not omit a restriction that changes what they should do.

targets.label: Separate an association from a causal claim
Make a precise reference across sentences

formModels.description: Un aumento coincide con… states a temporal association. Non basta a dimostrare che… limits the causal inference. Potrebbe dipendere da… introduces an alternative explanation; it does not establish that explanation.

Questa rilevazione names the previously described data collection; tale limite names its stated weakness. An explicit noun avoids ambiguous questo after several possible antecedents. A conclusion can recommend an action while retaining the evidence limit.

lessons.outcome: Practise follow a speaker’s qualification and reformulation. Readiness concerns the listed controlled distinctions; the connected application is optional self-review.

targets.label: Distinguish a hope from a commitment
Follow the correction without deleting stance

formModels.description: Speriamo di… and ci piacerebbe… express desired possibilities. Abbiamo deciso di… reports a decision. Do not turn the speaker’s hope into an announced plan; identify the wording that carries the commitment.

O meglio explicitly replaces an earlier wording; in altre parole restates it. Diciamo and più che altro can qualify how exactly an expression fits. These spoken markers organise meaning; they do not automatically indicate dishonesty or uncertainty about every fact.

targets.label: Restore the actor when simplifying a nominalisation
Simplify wording while retaining a restriction

formModels.description: La verifica dei dati names an action without necessarily naming its actor. When the source supplies the actor, a plain verb can restore it: l’ufficio verifica i dati. Do not invent an actor where none is specified.

An accessible brief can replace a formal phrase with familiar words, but entro, soltanto and dopo still determine the action. Explain an unfamiliar term in context instead of erasing a material condition.

lessons.title: Read an editorial’s implied contrast precisely
lessons.outcome: Practise read an editorial’s implied contrast precisely. Readiness concerns the listed controlled distinctions; the connected application is optional self-review.

targets.label: Keep the scope of a qualified denial
Separate explicit wording from a warranted implication

formModels.description: Non tutti rejects universality, not every member. Non soltanto expands beyond the named element rather than denying it. Non necessariamente weakens a guaranteed relation. These small scope words change what follows logically.

Ancora and finalmente can activate a prior state or expectation. A contextual implication is a reasoned reading, not a quoted explicit fact. Distinguish what the words assert, presuppose and merely suggest; do not infer an actor’s motive without evidence.

lessons.outcome: Practise preserve register and distance in a spoken account. Readiness concerns the listed controlled distinctions; the connected application is optional self-review.

targets.label: Attribute a claim without endorsing it
Interpret a spoken image within its situation

formModels.description: A detta di… reports a person’s claim; stando al documento attributes information to a document. The reported conditional can distance an unconfirmed assertion. Attribution alone does not prove or disprove what is reported.

Per così dire flags a figurative or approximate label. A humorous desire to sdoppiarsi at a crowded festival expresses the impossibility of attending simultaneous events, not a literal plan. Preserve the image’s practical implication and the spoken tone.

targets.label: Compare only compatible measures
Make the recommendation conditional on the unresolved fact

formModels.description: Two figures can differ because they use different periods, groups or definitions. A parità di periodo and con lo stesso criterio mark what must match. A differing figure is a conflict only after these scope differences are checked.

A short synthesis can rank evidence and still retain a dependency. Se la verifica confermerà… makes the action conditional. Salvo verifica marks a statement subject to checking. Keep the reason for the recommendation visible to its recipient.
